scope: Read-only single exact250 baseline. First classification is mutually exclusive first front/front kinematic descending centre crossing, with nonnegative/negative radius-clearance split. Geometric crossing and final OUT association do not establish causality. No new measurement or source changes.

traceSHA.timeOrigin: Physics time; phase0. timeStart/timeEnd are substep or motion intervals, contact/correction order is seq, gameTime is separate.
traceSHA.radiusAndPlane: All points carry actual r and leftLaunchPlane as front; read fixed.separateLaunchPlane. No visual-plane inference.

leftFirst713WindmillRelation.sampling: Minimum over all recorded front motion-before/after and both bodies before/after every changed contact. These cover actual integration and correction endpoints; substep boundary positions are repeated in these records. No trajectory resimulation or virtual arc interpolation. Swept all-angle envelope is not a solid disc; unchanged tangent touches are not contact records.
